Flow.description:
F-04: Multi-Country Lead Conversion Screen Flow. Launched via Convert Lead Quick Action. Shows a confirmation screen then automatically creates one Account (Company name), Contact, and one Opportunity per Target_Country__c value. Converts the Lead via LeadConversionHelper after all Opportunities are created.
V81: Country picklist update V83: Added Registred Office address mapping
SFDEV-46: Removed Sales team assignment from Stamp lead qualification fields onto Account node
